description: Read an owned edit and its applied, failed, skipped and pending changes. Pending means not sent yet, still waiting in the review; apply the same review again to send them. Both preview detail levels report settings.launch (allowed, approval or off) separately from the edit mode; settings.approvalRuleAppliesTo is edits. Edit approval does not gate new-ad launches. Review mode returns reviewUrl and no executable plan. Share reviewUrl with the user, do not apply, and reuse reviewId on later previews in the same conversation. EDITS_REVIEW_REQUIRED means approval must happen in your Agent Inbox. Always preview and show the user the changes. Set a confirm flag only after the user explicitly approves that change. Never retry a partial apply blindly. Archive and delete cannot be undone. Preview requests accept optional reason and runTitle. A per-operation reason overrides the top-level reason for that operation. Use one short evidence-based note for the Agent Inbox and reuse runTitle with the same reviewId.
name: ads_get_edit
title: Read Edit Results
